stuff-01.title: Rice Stuffing Mix (for Stuffed Vegetables)
stuff-01.servings: enough to stuff 1 kg of vegetables

instructions.1: Chop the onion, tomatoes, parsley, dill, and mint if using fresh.
instructions.2: Place the vegetables in a blender with the salt, pepper, and spices.
instructions.3: Wash the rice and drain it thoroughly.
instructions.4: Place the mixture in a pot over medium heat with the ghee or oil and lemon juice, and bring to a boil.
instructions.5: Mix the ingredients well with the rice until it is ready for stuffing.
instructions.6: The rice can be replaced with cooked minced meat (see Bab Al Louhoum).

stuff-02.title: Stuffed White or Black Baby Eggplants

instructions.1: Gently soften the eggplants by hand, then carefully slit them open.
instructions.2: Soak them in salted water for about half an hour, then drain.
instructions.3: Stuff them with the stuffing mixture according to the amount of vegetables, leaving a small space at the top of the eggplant unfilled.
instructions.4: Arrange them in a pot and pour in the tomato juice, water, salt, and pepper.
instructions.5: Add the ghee or oil, cover the pot, and cook over low heat until tender.
instructions.6: Add more water as needed during cooking.

instructions.1: Wash the peppers, carefully remove the stems, and remove the seeds.
instructions.2: Stuff with the stuffing mixture, leaving a small space so the stem opening can cover the top.
instructions.3: Arrange them in a pot and pour over the ghee or oil, along with the boiling water or broth seasoned with salt and pepper, if available.
instructions.4: Cover the pot and cook over low heat until tender.

stuff-04.title: Stuffed Zucchini with Rice or Assag

st4-2.name: stuffing mixture (rice-based or meat-based/osag) (see Bab Al Lahm)

st4-6.name: onion, tomato, and celery (for the bottom)

instructions.1: Place slices of onion, tomato, and celery at the bottom of the pot.
instructions.2: Carefully hollow out the zucchini after peeling, then stuff them with the filling mixture.
instructions.3: Arrange the zucchini in the pot and add the strained tomato juice, about half a cup of boiling water, salt, pepper, spices, and ghee.
instructions.4: Cover the pot and cook over low heat until tender.

st5-2.name: minced meat sauce (see Bab Al Louk recipes)

instructions.1: Peel the potatoes, carefully hollow them out, then wash with water and pat dry.
instructions.2: Par-fry the potatoes in oil.
instructions.3: Stuff them with the minced meat sauce and arrange them in a Pyrex dish to cook in the oven, or in a pot to cook on the stovetop.
instructions.4: Pour the tomato juice and the liquid seasoned with salt, pepper, and ghee over them.
instructions.5: Cover the pot and leave over low heat until cooked, or place in a medium-heat oven, covered, until cooked through.

st6-2.name: minced meat sauce with tomato (see Bab Al Lahoum recipe)

instructions.1: Stuff the artichokes with the minced meat sauce, arrange them in a pot, and pour the dam'a sauce over them.
instructions.2: Cover the pot and cook over low heat, or arrange them in a baking dish and place in the oven, covered, until cooked through.
instructions.3: You may top the artichokes with a layer of béchamel sauce if cooking them in the oven.

instructions.1: Sauté the garlic in ghee or oil, then pour in the tomato juice and simmer on low heat until cooked, then add the vinegar, water, salt, and pepper.

st8-2.name: filling mixture (with rice or minced meat sauce - see Bab Al Lahm recipes)
st8-2.standardAmount: 1 cup rice or ¼ kg minced meat sauce

st8-7.name: thinly sliced onion rubbed with salt/pepper, and tomato slices (for the bottom)

instructions.1: Wash the grape leaves repeatedly in cold water, then spread them out and arrange them.
instructions.2: Blanch each batch in boiling water with a pinch of salt, then carefully remove and place in a colander.
instructions.3: Trim the stems of the leaves, then lay each leaf flat with the smooth side facing up.
instructions.4: Place a small amount of the filling mixture on the leaf and roll it tightly like a finger until the mixture is finished.
instructions.5: Line the bottom of the pot with a thin layer of unstuffed grape leaves, along with thinly sliced onions rubbed with salt and pepper, tomato slices, a little chopped garlic, and lemon.
instructions.6: Arrange the stuffed leaves neatly in the pot and pour the lemon juice, ghee, and garlic over them.
instructions.7: Place the pot over low heat and cover for 3 minutes, then pour in a little broth or salted water and cover until cooked through.

stuff-09.title: Stuffed Cabbage Rolls with Dill and Cumin

st9-3.name: stuffing mixture without parsley, mint, or meat (see recipe above)

instructions.1: Remove the outer green leaves, separate the remaining leaves from one another, and wash them carefully.
instructions.2: Boil water seasoned with salt and cumin, drop a quantity of leaves into the hot water, and leave until tender, then remove carefully; repeat until all leaves are processed.
instructions.3: Stuff each leaf with a small amount of the stuffing mixture.
instructions.4: Roll them into finger shapes, ensuring the smooth side faces outward.
instructions.5: Arrange them neatly in a pot and place over low heat for 5 minutes.
instructions.6: Pour the tomato juice and a little broth or salted water over them.
instructions.7: Leave over medium heat until nearly cooked, then reduce the heat until fully tender.

stuff-10.title: Savory Qatayef Stuffed with Assag or Shakshuka

st10-2.name: Minced meat mixture or shakshuka (see Bab Al Louk or the following recipe)

instructions.1: Place a portion of the filling inside the qatayef, then fold them in half, pressing the edges together until they stick.
instructions.2: Fry in hot ghee or oil, then remove and place on paper towels.
instructions.3: Sprinkle with grated cheese and serve.
instructions.4: Qatayef can also be stuffed with cheese and butter mixed with chopped arugula.

instructions.1: Grate the onion and sauté in ghee or oil until golden, then add the finely chopped bell pepper and stir just twice.
instructions.2: Whisk the eggs and season well with salt, pepper, and spices, then pour over the onion and pepper over medium heat, stirring until the vegetables and eggs are combined and set.

bake-02.title: Phyllo Pie with Assag and Milk-Egg Custard

bk2-4.name: Asaj (seasoned minced meat; see Meat section)

instructions.1: Prepare the phyllo by placing half of it in a tray lightly greased with ghee.
instructions.2: Spread the asaj over half of the phyllo, then cover it with the remaining phyllo sheets.
instructions.3: Cut the pastry into pieces before putting it in the oven and pour the ghee over it.
instructions.4: Place in a medium-heat oven for approximately half an hour until the phyllo turns golden yellow.
instructions.5: Boil the milk and season it with salt, pepper, and spices; once cooled, add the well-beaten eggs.
instructions.6: Pour the milk and egg mixture over the phyllo along with a tablespoon of ghee, and leave it in the oven until the top browns, then cover it and turn off the oven.

bk3-3.name: Beef shawarma filling (refer to Meat Gate recipe)

instructions.1: Lightly grease a baking tray with ghee, then layer the phyllo sheets one by one, brushing each with a little broth mixed with oil or ghee.
instructions.2: Spread the filling over half of the phyllo layers.
instructions.3: Layer the remaining phyllo sheets using the same method, brush the top with ghee, and cut into pieces.
instructions.4: Once fully cooked and the top is golden brown, pour one cup of cold broth over it.
instructions.5: Leave it inside the oven until it absorbs the liquid, then cover it and turn off the oven.

instructions.1: Prepare a greased baking dish and layer half of the phyllo dough, then add the cream, followed by the remaining half of the phyllo dough, and top with the ghee, then cut into pieces.
instructions.2: Bake in a medium-heat oven until golden brown.
instructions.3: Pour the cold milk or cold broth over it and let it sit until the liquid is fully absorbed, then cover it and turn off the oven.

bake-05.title: Savory Custard Cream with Lemon Zest and Cold Cuts

bk5-8.name: salt, pepper, spice, cinnamon, and cloves

instructions.1: Bring the milk to a boil and add the spices and the washed lemon zest.
instructions.2: Whisk the eggs with the flour until well combined, then add to the hot milk while whisking continuously over low heat, then stir in the parsley.
instructions.3: Increase the heat and add the luncheon meat pieces.

bk6-7.name: lemon juice and vinegar
bk6-7.standardAmount: juice of 1/2 lemon + a little vinegar

instructions.1: Rub the ghee with the oil until well combined, then mix in the flour, and crack the eggs over the mixture and rub them together thoroughly.
instructions.2: Squeeze the lemon juice into a little water and pour it over the mixture until a soft dough forms, adding more water as needed, then cover and let rest for 15 minutes.
instructions.3: Lightly grease a baking tray with ghee or oil.
instructions.4: Roll out the dough on a dry surface dusted with flour, then stuff it with an appropriate amount of cheese mixed with butter.
instructions.5: Cut the dough into shapes using a cup, folding the edges to seal the filling inside.
instructions.6: Arrange them in the tray, brush the tops with egg, and bake in a medium oven until the tops are golden brown.

bake-07.title: Phyllo Pie with Chicken, Vegetables and Béchamel

bk7-11.name: salt, pepper, mixed spices, cinnamon, and thyme

instructions.1: Grate the carrot and pepper, then dice the onion into small cubes.
instructions.2: Sauté the onion in oil or ghee, add the minced garlic, stir, and remove from heat.
instructions.3: Mix the grated carrot and pepper with the boiled peas and season with all the spices; add the curry and pieces of olives, then mix everything with the onion and garlic mixture.
instructions.4: Mix the bechamel sauce with the small pieces of boiled chicken.
instructions.5: Pour the bechamel over the vegetable mixture and stir well.
instructions.6: Grease a baking tray with ghee and layer half of the phyllo pastry, lightly brushing it with ghee.
instructions.7: Spread the bechamel mixture over the pastry, cover with the remaining phyllo, top with 1 tablespoon of ghee, and cut into pieces.
instructions.8: Bake in a medium-heat oven until the top is golden brown.
instructions.9: Once cooked, pour the cup of cold milk (seasoned with salt and pepper) over the dish and let it absorb; then cover it and turn off the oven.

bk8-2.name: shakshuka (see recipe in the fillings section)

instructions.1: Grease a baking tray with ghee and layer half of the phyllo pastry, lightly brushing each layer with ghee.
instructions.2: Spread the shakshuka over the pastry, cover with the remaining half of the phyllo, top with 1 tablespoon of ghee, and cut into pieces.
instructions.3: Place in a medium-heat oven until the top is golden brown.
instructions.4: Once cooked, pour the cold milk (seasoned with salt and pepper) over the pastry and let it soak up the liquid, then cover it and turn off the oven.

bake-09.title: Ruqaq — Layered Flatbread with Assag in Broth

instructions.1: Bring the broth to a boil and keep it on very low heat until the pastry is assembled; add 1 tablespoon of ghee and season with pepper and spices.
instructions.2: Prepare a tray greased with ghee, then place the first layer of roqaq sheets, being careful not to dip the bottom of the sheets into the broth so they do not stick to the tray.
instructions.3: Moisten only the top surface with the hot broth.
instructions.4: Take the sheets one by one and lightly moisten both sides with the hot broth, being careful not to let the pastry break, and layer them in the tray until half the quantity is used.
instructions.5: Spread the minced meat filling over the layer, then begin layering the remaining roqaq sheets moistened with the boiling broth until finished.
instructions.6: Brush the top of the tray with ghee and place in a medium-heat oven until the top turns golden brown.
instructions.7: Carefully flip the pastry onto the other side and return to the oven until the other side is golden brown.
instructions.8: Immediately cover the pastry after removing it from the oven to keep it soft.

des-03.title: Simple Pancakes with Molasses or Jam

instructions.1: Add the baking powder to the flour, then mix with the oil and vanilla, gradually adding milk until the batter reaches a medium-soft consistency.
instructions.2: Heat the oil in a non-stick pan, then pour one tablespoon of the mixture into the oil or butter; flip on both sides until golden, repeating the process one by one.
instructions.3: Once the batter is finished, place the pancakes on a flat plate and begin decorating them.
instructions.4: Top with a little butter and black honey or jam; you can also add a layer of custard and nuts.

des-04.title: Chocolate Caramel Pancake Stack with Strawberries

instructions.1: Melt the butter with the milk in a saucepan over medium heat.
instructions.2: Mix the flour with the baking powder, then add them to the sugar and combine.
instructions.3: Whisk the eggs and vanilla into the milk and butter mixture, then pour the liquid into the flour and sugar mixture and whisk with a wire whisk.
instructions.4: Place the batter in the refrigerator for about 45 minutes.
instructions.5: Prepare a non-stick pan with a little oil and heat it slightly.
instructions.6: Fill a ladle with batter and pour it into the pan until it is full.
instructions.7: Once the batter sets, flip it to the other side until golden brown, then remove and place on a plate.
instructions.8: Lightly grease the pan with oil and repeat the process, stacking the pancakes two at a time in the plate until the batter is finished.
instructions.9: To garnish, spread chocolate caramel on one pancake, place the second pancake on top, then add more caramel on top and surround with strawberries.
instructions.10: Alternatively, garnish by making whipped cream mixed with chopped nuts; spread this on the first layer, cover with the second, and decorate the sides with whipped cream and the center with strawberries and cream.

instructions.1: Place the sugar in a pan with a little water and cook until it turns slightly golden and becomes caramel.
instructions.2: Add the cream to the caramel, stirring over low heat until completely melted, then add the grated chocolate.

instructions.1: Combine the baking powder and flour, then add half of the sugar and mix well.
instructions.2: Melt the butter in a pan, add the sliced apples and the remaining half of the sugar, cook until the apples are soft and absorb the mixture, then set aside to cool.
instructions.3: In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the buttermilk and vanilla, then add the flour all at once and mix slightly.
instructions.4: Prepare a Pyrex dish and arrange the apple pieces inside, topping them with orange zest.
instructions.5: Pour the batter over the apples without stirring, then refrigerate for 30 minutes.
instructions.6: Bake in a medium-heat oven, keeping an eye on it as it cooks quickly.
instructions.7: Invert the pancakes onto a serving plate.

des-07.title: Fried Sweet Fatayer with Sugar or Honey

instructions.1: Add the baking powder to the flour, rub well with the ghee, and add the water as needed.
instructions.2: Cover the mixture and let it rest for about fifteen minutes.
instructions.3: Shape the dough into small lemon-sized balls, then flatten them on a board or tray until they are very thin, about the size of a tea saucer.
instructions.4: Heat plenty of oil in a wide pan and fry the pieces one by one, then place them on a rectangular plate.
instructions.5: Sprinkle the pieces with powdered sugar, white honey, or black honey.

des-08.title: Apricot Jam Lattice Tart (Pasta Frolla Style)

instructions.1: Combine the baking powder and a pinch of salt with the flour and ghee, rubbing them together well with your fingertips.
instructions.2: Beat the eggs with the vanilla, add the sugar, and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the flour mixture to the egg and sugar mixture, mixing well until a medium-soft dough forms.
instructions.4: Place the dough in the refrigerator for 30 minutes.
instructions.5: Lightly grease a baking pan with butter and press two-thirds of the dough into the pan, covering the sides.
instructions.6: Spread the apricot jam (or any fruit preserve) over the base.
instructions.7: Cut the remaining third of the dough into strips and lay them over the jam in a lattice pattern.
instructions.8: Brush the surface with beaten egg and bake in a medium-heat oven until golden and cooked through.

des-09.title: Phyllo Pie with Custard and Nuts

instructions.1: Lightly grease the baking tray and place half of the goulash sheets inside without cutting them.
instructions.2: Spread the filling over the goulash, then sprinkle with the chopped nuts, raisins, and coconut.
instructions.3: Cover with the remaining goulash sheets, then heat the 1/2 cup of oil or melted ghee thoroughly and pour it over the dough before placing it in the oven.
instructions.4: When it is nearly done, pour the cup of cold milk over it; there is no need for heavy cream to avoid making it too rich.
instructions.5: Return it to the oven for a short time until all the liquid is absorbed and the top is golden brown.
instructions.6: Immediately after removing from the oven, sprinkle with powdered sugar and cover.

instructions.1: Whisk the eggs, then add two tablespoons of milk and mix. Add the cornstarch and whisk well with the cinnamon and vanilla.
instructions.2: Boil the milk with the sugar, then pour a little of the hot milk into the egg mixture (to help it dissolve smoothly), then pour the mixture back into the boiling milk. Whisk well over low heat until the consistency thickens.

des-11.title: Phyllo Pie with Milk and Molasses

instructions.1: Lightly grease the baking tray and layer all the goulash sheets inside without cutting them.
instructions.2: Heat the half cup of oil or ghee thoroughly, pour it over the goulash, and place in a medium-heat oven.
instructions.3: As it nears completion, pour the large cup of cold milk mixed with cream over the pastry.
instructions.4: Return it to the oven until the liquid is absorbed and the top is golden, then cover immediately after removing from the oven.
instructions.5: Serve this pie hot with black honey for dipping.

des-12.title: Sweet Ruqaq with Nuts, Raisins and Cinnamon

instructions.1: Grease a baking tray thoroughly with ghee, place the first dry layer of roqaq sheets, then moisten half of the sheets one by one with water or milk and layer them in the tray.
instructions.2: Spread the chopped nuts, raisins, and cinnamon over the first layer of roqaq.
instructions.3: Cover the filling with the remaining half of the roqaq sheets and brush the top with ghee.
instructions.4: Place in a medium-heat oven until halfway cooked, then carefully flip the tray to cook the other side.
instructions.5: Once fully cooked, turn off the heat, pour the cup of milk and a little cinnamon over the pastry, then cover it and return it to the oven until the pastry softens.

instructions.1: Prepare a bowl and add the flour and salt.
instructions.2: Whisk the eggs with the milk and vanilla, then pour the mixture over the flour and stir well with a wooden spoon until a smooth, liquid batter forms.
instructions.3: Prepare a Teflon pan and add a little oil.
instructions.4: Fill a small cup or a large spoon with the batter and carefully pour it into the hot pan, spreading it to form a thin disc.
instructions.5: Shake the pan and flip the crepe like a cannoli or omelet to cook the other side until it sets and turns golden.
instructions.6: Remove from the pan and place on a plate, repeating the process until all the batter is used to create thin crepes.
instructions.7: Fill each crepe with an amount of jam, then roll them up like a roll and arrange them on a serving plate.
instructions.8: Dust with powdered sugar on all sides and sprinkle with crushed nuts, raisins, and coconut.
instructions.9: You can also add a little whipped cream on top of the powdered sugar.

des-14.title: French-Style Apple Tart with Custard Glaze

instructions.1: Lightly grease a round Pyrex dish with butter, then spread the puff pastry, leaving a 2 cm border at the edges, and prick the surface with a fork.
instructions.2: Peel the apples and cut each into 8 slices, then arrange the apple slices over the pastry.
instructions.3: Sprinkle 3 tablespoons of sugar over the apples and bake in the oven for about 30 minutes.
instructions.4: Whisk the egg, cream, powdered sugar, and vanilla together thoroughly with a whisk.
instructions.5: Remove the Pyrex from the oven, pour the egg and cream mixture over the apples, and return to the oven until golden brown.

db16-8.name: minced meat, Rumi cheese, or white cheese with mint

instructions.1: Mix the yeast with a little sugar, then gradually add the warm water and let it sit until activated.
instructions.2: Beat the eggs well, then gradually add the flour until a somewhat firm dough forms.
instructions.3: Add the yeast mixture to the dough along with the lemon juice and a pinch of salt, then mix well.
instructions.4: Roll out the dough on a floured surface to a thickness of 0.5 cm.
instructions.5: Drizzle the melted ghee over the surface until absorbed, then roll or fold it like a pastry and let it rest.
instructions.6: Roll it out a second time, then cut and shape it into triangles.
instructions.7: Fill with either minced meat, Rumi cheese, white cheese with mint, or leave plain.
instructions.8: Roll each triangle into a crescent shape and place on a greased baking sheet, then let rise.
instructions.9: Brush the tops with egg wash or sweetened milk.
instructions.10: Bake in a high-temperature oven until golden brown and cooked through.

db17-5.name: nuts, raisins, coconut, and grated chocolate (optional)

instructions.1: Whisk one egg in a deep bowl with a pinch of vanilla thoroughly.
instructions.2: Place the slice of toast in the mixture and let it soak for a moment, then carefully flip it to the other side until the egg is fully absorbed.
instructions.3: Heat the butter or ghee in a small non-stick pan, carefully place the toast in the pan over low heat, and flip carefully until both sides are golden without burning.
instructions.4: Prepare a plate sized to the toast and sprinkle it with powdered sugar, place the toast on the plate, and sprinkle more powdered sugar on top.
instructions.5: Nuts, raisins, coconut, or grated chocolate can be added over the powdered sugar.
instructions.6: The toast can also be garnished by melting apricot jam with a little water over low heat, then mixing in finely chopped fruits like apples, pears, or dates with a little butter, and pouring the mixture over the toast; alternatively, garnish with caramel, grated chocolate with chopped fruit or ice cream, or cook apples with cinnamon and sugar and pour the sauce over the toast.

instructions.1: Dissolve the cornstarch in about half a cup of cold milk.
instructions.2: Place the remaining milk over medium heat and sweeten with sugar until it reaches a boil.
instructions.3: Take about one large ladle of the boiling milk and pour it into the cornstarch mixture, stirring well to combine.
instructions.4: Pour this mixture into the rest of the boiling milk, stirring well after removing from the heat.
instructions.5: Return the mixture to low heat for approximately 3 minutes while stirring constantly.
instructions.6: Add the vanilla, then pour the pudding into small molds lightly moistened with cold water.
instructions.7: Leave to cool, then garnish with nuts and raisins, or pistachios, coconut, sliced bananas, strawberries, or cherries.
instructions.8: Can also be garnished with whipped cream topped with fruit or nuts, or served with ice cream.

instructions.1: Dissolve the cornstarch in about half a cup of cold milk.
instructions.2: Place the remaining milk over medium heat and sweeten with sugar until it reaches a boil.
instructions.3: Dissolve the chocolate or cocoa powder into the sweetened milk.
instructions.4: Take about one large ladle of the boiling milk and pour it over the cornstarch mixture, stirring well until smooth.
instructions.5: Pour this mixture into the rest of the boiling milk, stirring well after removing from the heat.
instructions.6: Return the mixture to low heat for approximately 3 minutes, stirring constantly.
instructions.7: Add the vanilla, then pour the pudding into small molds lightly moistened with cold water.
instructions.8: Leave to cool, then garnish with nuts and raisins, pistachios, coconut, sliced bananas, strawberries, or cherries.
instructions.9: Garnish with grated chocolate, nuts, or chocolate ice cream.

des-19.title: Jelly with Fresh Fruit and Biscuits

instructions.1: Dissolve the jelly powder in boiling water, stirring well until completely dissolved; you may add a little sugar if desired, then set aside to cool.
instructions.2: In a deep bowl or large serving dish, combine the crushed biscuits and chopped fruit, then pour in the jelly and mix well.
instructions.3: Place in the refrigerator until set firmly.
instructions.4: Garnish with whipped cream, liquid caramel, or custard with coconut.

instructions.1: Prepare small bowls or cups by lightly wetting them with water.
instructions.2: Crush some biscuits as desired and place them at the bottom of the bowls.
instructions.3: Dissolve the cornstarch in about half a cup of cold milk; place the remaining milk over medium heat and sweeten with sugar until boiling.
instructions.4: Dissolve the chocolate or cocoa powder into the sweetened milk.
instructions.5: Take about one large ladle of the boiling milk and pour it into the cornstarch mixture to loosen it, stirring well; then pour this mixture into the rest of the boiling milk, stirring well after removing from heat.
instructions.6: Return the mixture to low heat for approximately 3 minutes, stirring constantly.
instructions.7: Add the vanilla, then pour the pudding over the biscuits.
instructions.8: Once cooled, top with grated or finely chopped chocolate. You can also sprinkle the surface with nuts, raisins, or coconut.

instructions.1: Mix the corn flour with a little milk thoroughly.
instructions.2: Warm the remaining milk in a pot over low heat, then pour the flour mixture into the milk and stir for 5 minutes.
instructions.3: Remove the mixture from the heat and add the butter, molasses, sugar, and baking powder, stirring well until the butter is completely melted.
instructions.4: Whisk the egg with the vanilla, then pour it over the pudding mixture.
instructions.5: Grease a small Pyrex dish with butter, pour in the mixture, and pour the remaining milk over the top.
instructions.6: Place the dish in a large tray filled halfway with hot water (water bath) and bake in a very low oven, ensuring you add more water if the level drops in the tray.
instructions.7: Continue baking for about two hours until the top is golden brown.

instructions.1: Dissolve the cornstarch in a small amount of cold milk.
instructions.2: Boil the remaining milk, then temper the cornstarch mixture by adding a little hot milk to it; pour the mixture back into the boiling milk while stirring constantly, then add the coconut.
instructions.3: Add the semolina to the mixture, stirring continuously and rapidly with a whisk over low heat for 10 minutes until the consistency thickens slightly.
instructions.4: Add the sugar and vanilla or mastic, continuing to stir until the sugar dissolves, then let it cool before placing it in the refrigerator.
instructions.5: Prepare a Pyrex dish to pour the pudding into, then garnish with whipped cream and top with banana or strawberry slices.
instructions.6: It can also be garnished with nuts, raisins, and coconut.

instructions.1: Dissolve the cornstarch in a little bit of cold milk.
instructions.2: Boil the remaining milk, then add a small amount of it to the cornstarch mixture and stir; pour the mixture back into the boiling milk while stirring constantly.
instructions.3: Add the semolina to the mixture, stirring continuously and rapidly with a whisk over low heat for 10 minutes until the consistency thickens slightly.
instructions.4: Add the sugar and vanilla or mastic, continuing to stir until the sugar is completely dissolved.
instructions.5: Prepare a Pyrex dish, layer the cold caramel at the bottom, pour the basbousa pudding on top, and place in the refrigerator.
instructions.6: When serving, you can either flip the pudding onto a serving plate or leave it in the Pyrex dish as is, depending on preference.
